Abstractions/ITenantKeyResolver.cs.reason: Interfaces have no implementation to test

justifications.guard: The attribute has only auto-properties and a parameterless constructor, so there is no guard clause to test.
justifications.contract: The contract tests instantiate the attribute and pin its defaults and its exact public surface (KeyId and UseTenantKey, no opt-out member).

MessageEncryptionOptions.cs.reason: Configuration POCO with defaults and validation

justifications.unit: The options tests read every default and set every property.
justifications.contract: The contract tests pin every default value of the options class.

justifications.unit: Every encrypt/decrypt path, both failure paths, the marked-or-EncryptAllMessages predicate and the runtime-type resolution (interface, base type and null message) are unit tested; only the tracing and metrics branches stay partly uncovered.
